name: @repo/ai
description: Thin wrapper so turbo can run the Python service's tasks alongside the TypeScript ones.

scripts.dev: sh -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT INT TERM; bun run dev:api & bun run dev:worker & wait'
scripts.dev:api: bun --env-file=../../.env run sh -c 'exec uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port "$AI_PORT"'
scripts.dev:worker: bun --env-file=../../.env run uv run watchfiles --filter python 'python -m app.worker' app
scripts.start: bun --env-file=../../.env run sh -c 'exec uv run fastapi run app/main.py --port "$AI_PORT"'
scripts.gen: rm -rf app/contracts && uv run datamodel-codegen --input ../../packages/jobs/generated/schemas --input-file-type jsonschema --output app/contracts --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --target-python-version 3.14 --use-standard-collections --use-union-operator --field-constraints --disable-timestamp --use-double-quotes --use-title-as-name --enum-field-as-literal all --use-type-alias --formatters ruff-format && uv run ruff format app/contracts && uv run ruff check --fix --quiet app/contracts && cp ../../packages/jobs/generated/queue-settings.json app/contracts/queue_settings.json && cp ../../packages/jobs/generated/error-codes.json app/contracts/error_codes.json && cp ../../packages/jobs/generated/realtime-channels.json app/contracts/realtime_channels.json && uv run python -m app.export_openapi openapi.json
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run deptry .
scripts.worker: bun --env-file=../../.env run uv run python -m app.worker
scripts.evals: bun --env-file=../../.env run uv run python -m evals
scripts.coverage: uv run pytest -m 'integration or not integration' --cov --cov-report=term --cov-report=lcov:coverage/lcov.info
